forensic_metrics.financial: Stabilized Stand CoGS which had crept 'way higher' due to rigidity measures [1]
forensic_metrics.process: Recovered from 50-74% yield failure on PPI Side Caps to active shipping [2, 3]
forensic_metrics.governance: Weekly 'QA Top 10' / 'Line Down' Crisis Management on production floor [4, 5]

forensic_summary.trigger: Post-FCS 'Line Down' crisis halted D-Control shipments for 3-4 weeks due to warping and bonding defects in structural foam side caps (yields <50%) [2].
forensic_summary.intervention: Erik Norris volunteered as 'point guy'; released ECO 6310 to increase mounting boss diameter/height; forced vendor (PPI) to modify tooling to eliminate downward-facing bosses [5, 6].
forensic_summary.result: Stabilized production line, resolved critical 'gap' and 'paint adhesion' issues, and resumed regular system shipments [2, 7].

war_stories.label: The Side Cap Meltdown
war_stories.description: Structural foam parts warped and cracked; rescued by ECO 6310 resizing bosses to tolerate molding variances [2, 6].

war_stories.label: The Rigidity Fix
war_stories.description: Consolidated extrusion profiles to a single unified design to offset costs of added steel stiffeners required for stand rigidity [8, 9].

war_stories.label: The Stripped PEMs
war_stories.description: Sheet metal inserts stripped during install due to torque required to align warped plastics; resolved by widening plastic clearance holes [9, 10].

isomorphics.label: Tolerance
isomorphics.hardware_point: Widening bolt holes (ECO 6310) allows imperfectly molded plastic to assemble without stress.
isomorphics.software_point: Loose coupling / Postel's Law (be liberal in what you accept) in API design.

quotes: These side cap problems have prevented us from shipping DCtrl systems on a regular basis for the last 3-4 weeks. [2]
The stand CoGS have already crept *way* higher than we were expecting them to (largely due to the measures that were taken to improve strength and rigidity). [1]
Erik Norris volunteered to be point guy from the Mechanical group on these issues. [5]
